text:
Maya R: FYI I'm going to roll a tiny canary this afternoon that flips `route_logging.ttl` 24h -> 7d for routes tagged `dev`. This is to help debug recurring flakiness where traces are missing. Need a quick sync on how this interacts with inspect console, PII retention, and quotas. cc @JordanK @AnyaP :eyes:

Jordan K: Quick q — will those dev logs be redacted/masked? We can't keep raw user content for 7 days for EU customers. Also what's the sampling rate change?

Anya P: My preference: keep 7d for headers/metadata, but pseudonymize request/response bodies. Hash + salt per-tenant so dev engineers can still triage without seeing plain PII. Sampling still at 1% across prod routes, 100% for these dev-tagged routes in the canary.

Leo S: Heads up on cost: if we un-sample dev routes we'll see token/storage spikes. Need the dashboard owners to watch token-store-by-route for the next 48h. Can we gate with a quota increment so we don't blow committed capacity? :money_with_wings:

Samuel O: Legal: for eu-xxx tenants we need to ensure data doesn't cross regions. If any dev routes touch EU tenants we should override TTL back to 24h for those tenants.

Maya R: Proposed config for the canary (applies to routes with tag=dev):
```
{
  "route_match": "tag:dev",
  "logging": {
    "enabled": true,
    "ttl_days": 7,
    "redaction": {
      "mode": "pseudonymize",
      "fields": ["request.body","response.body"],
      "per_tenant_salt": true
    },
    "sampling": {
      "global_rate": "1%",
      "override_rate": "100%"
    }
  },
  "quota_gate": {
    "enabled": true,
    "max_tokens_increment": 100000
  }
}
```

Jordan K: We should also emit telemetry events `logging.canary.start` / `logging.canary.revert` with reason and diff so console can surface an audit ribbon. Also auto-revert after 48h unless manually extended.

Anya P: Agree. Also want an explicit Console UX: a bright warning when enabling extended inspect on a tenant with EU region data -> require 2nd click + small reason text.

Leo S: I'll wire a temporary alert on the infra dashboard: `route.dev.logging_tokens` > 2x baseline -> page oncall.

Maya R: SGTM. I'll add the telemetry events and the auto-revert TTL. Can someone pair on adding the Console ack flow? @AnyaP?

Anya P: I can start a quick PR tomorrow AM.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for 2 nodes in us-west-2 (canary id: canary-600111). Watch logs at https://deploys.redwood.internal/canary-600111 :rocket:

Leo S: :thumbsup:

Samuel O: :warning: reminder — don't forget to update privacy note for debug sessions.

Maya R: noted, will update the audit doc and ping legal if any EU tenants are affected. Thanks all.
